name: Nora of the Treaty Stone

intro.text: Three hundred years and more this stone has stood here. I've stood here a fair while myself. Beat me and you'll have the city's respect. Lose and you'll have its sympathy, which is worse.

win: Well. The city will be talking. They always are.
after: Sarsfield said, after the Treaty, 'Change kings with us, and we'll fight you again.' I feel the same about battles.
